component.name: servicenow
component.title: ServiceNow
component.description: Query and change records, attachments, import sets and service catalog items of a ServiceNow instance through its REST API.
component.label: api,cloud,management

configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it.

display.description: Which scorecards a scorecards request returns by the Display field of their indicator: true for only those with Display selected, all for any (sysparm_display). The CamelServiceNowDisplay header replaces this option.

displayValue.description: Whether ServiceNow returns the display values (true), the actual values (false) or both (all) of the fields (sysparm_display_value). The CamelServiceNowDisplayValue header replaces this option.

excludeReferenceLink.description: Whether ServiceNow leaves out the Table API links of reference fields in the response (sysparm_exclude_reference_link). The CamelServiceNowExcludeReferenceLink header replaces this option.

favorites.description: Whether a scorecards request returns only the scorecards that are favorites of the user (sysparm_favorites). The CamelServiceNowFavorites header replaces this option.

includeAggregates.description: Whether a scorecards request returns all available aggregates of an indicator, also when an aggregate is already applied (sysparm_include_aggregates). The CamelServiceNowIncludeAggregates header replaces this option.

includeAvailableAggregates.description: Whether a scorecards request returns all available aggregates of an indicator when no aggregate is applied (sysparm_include_available_aggregates). The CamelServiceNowIncludeAvailableAggregates header replaces this option.

includeAvailableBreakdowns.description: Whether a scorecards request returns all available breakdowns of an indicator (sysparm_include_available_breakdowns). The CamelServiceNowIncludeAvailableBreakdowns header replaces this option.

includeScoreNotes.description: Whether a scorecards request returns the notes of each score, with their text, author and time (sysparm_include_score_notes). The CamelServiceNowIncludeScoreNotes header replaces this option.

includeScores.description: Whether a scorecards request returns all scores of a scorecard instead of only the most recent one (sysparm_include_scores). The CamelServiceNowIncludeScores header replaces this option.

inputDisplayValue.description: Whether ServiceNow treats the field values of a create or change as display values instead of actual values (sysparm_input_display_value). The CamelServiceNowInputDisplayValue header replaces this option.

key.description: Whether a scorecards request returns only the scorecards of key indicators (sysparm_key). The CamelServiceNowKey header replaces this option.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

models.description: The model class per table name, used for both the request and the response. A table with no class uses a Map. The CamelServiceNowModel header replaces this option. This is a multi-value option with prefix: model.

perPage.description: The maximum number of scorecards that a scorecards request returns per page, at most 100 (sysparm_per_page). The CamelServiceNowPerPage header replaces this option.

release.description: The ServiceNow release whose REST APIs the producer calls. FUJI supports the table, aggregate and import resources, and HELSINKI all resources. GENEVA is not supported.

requestModels.description: The class of the request body per table name. The producer fails when the body is not an instance of it, and a table with no class uses a Map. The CamelServiceNowRequestModel and CamelServiceNowModel headers replace this option. This is a multi-value option with prefix: request-model.

resource.description: The REST API that the producer calls when the CamelServiceNowResource header is not set: table, aggregate, import, attachment, scorecards, misc, service_catalog, service_catalog_items, service_catalog_cart or service_catalog_categories. The FUJI release supports only table, aggregate and import.

responseModels.description: The class per table name that the producer converts the result to. A table with no class uses a Map. The CamelServiceNowResponseModel and CamelServiceNowModel headers replace this option. This is a multi-value option with prefix: response-model.

sortBy.description: The value that a scorecards request sorts the scorecards by (sysparm_sortby). If not set, ServiceNow sorts by value. The CamelServiceNowSortBy header replaces this option.

sortDir.description: The sort direction of a scorecards request, asc or desc (sysparm_sortdir). If not set, ServiceNow sorts in descending order. The CamelServiceNowSortDir header replaces this option.

suppressAutoSysField.description: Whether ServiceNow does not generate the system fields, such as sys_updated_on, when a record is created or changed (sysparm_suppress_auto_sys_field). The CamelServiceNowSuppressAutoSysField header replaces this option.

suppressPaginationHeader.description: Whether ServiceNow leaves out the Link header of the response (sysparm_suppress_pagination_header), from which the producer sets the CamelServiceNowOffsetNext, CamelServiceNowOffsetPrev, CamelServiceNowOffsetFirst and CamelServiceNowOffsetLast headers. The CamelServiceNowSuppressPaginationHeader header replaces this option.

table.description: The name of the table, for example incident, for the table, aggregate and import resources. The CamelServiceNowTable header replaces this option. The table name also selects the class of the models, requestModels and responseModels options.

target.description: Whether a scorecards request returns only the scorecards that have a target (sysparm_target). The CamelServiceNowTarget header replaces this option.

topLevelOnly.description: Whether the categories of a catalog (the categories subject of the service_catalog resource) are only those whose parent is the catalog (sysparm_top_level_only). The CamelServiceNowTopLevelOnly header replaces this option.

apiVersion.label: advanced
apiVersion.description: The version of the REST API, for example v1, which the producer adds to the request path. If not set, the path has no version and ServiceNow uses the latest one. The CamelServiceNowApiVersion header replaces this option.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

dateFormat.label: advanced
dateFormat.description: The java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter pattern of the LocalDate fields of the models in the JSON. It is not used when the mapper option is set.

dateTimeFormat.label: advanced
dateTimeFormat.description: The java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter pattern of the LocalDateTime fields of the models in the JSON. It is not used when the mapper option is set.

httpClientPolicy.label: advanced
httpClientPolicy.description: To use a custom Apache CXF org.apache.cxf.transports.http.configuration.HTTPClientPolicy for the HTTP connection, for example for timeouts. When it is set, the proxyHost and proxyPort options are not used.

instanceName.label: advanced
instanceName.description: The name of the ServiceNow instance for the endpoints whose URI does not name one.

mapper.label: advanced
mapper.description: To use a custom Jackson tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper, which must be a JsonMapper, to convert the request and the response. When it is set, the dateFormat, timeFormat and dateTimeFormat options are not used.

proxyAuthorizationPolicy.label: advanced
proxyAuthorizationPolicy.description: To use a custom Apache CXF org.apache.cxf.configuration.security.ProxyAuthorizationPolicy for the authentication to the proxy. When it is set, the proxyUserName and proxyPassword options are not used.

retrieveTargetRecordOnImport.label: advanced
retrieveTargetRecordOnImport.description: Whether the create action of the import resource returns the record that the import inserted into the target table, which the producer reads with a second request, instead of the import set result. The CamelServiceNowRetrieveTargetRecord header replaces this option.

timeFormat.label: advanced
timeFormat.description: The java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter pattern of the LocalTime fields of the models in the JSON. It is not used when the mapper option is set.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the HTTP proxy. The proxy is used only when proxyPort is also set and httpClientPolicy is not set.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the HTTP proxy, used with proxyHost.

apiUrl.label: security
apiUrl.description: The base URL of the ServiceNow REST API. If not set, https://{instanceName}.service-now.com/api is used.

oauthClientId.label: security
oauthClientId.description: The client ID of the OAuth application in ServiceNow. When it and oauthClientSecret are set, the producer gets an access token from oauthTokenUrl with the password grant of userName and password, and sends the token instead of basic authentication.

oauthClientSecret.label: security
oauthClientSecret.description: The client secret of the OAuth application in ServiceNow, used with oauthClientId.

oauthTokenUrl.label: security
oauthTokenUrl.description: The URL of the OAuth token endpoint of ServiceNow. If not set, https://{instanceName}.service-now.com/oauth_token.do is used.

password.label: security
password.description: The password of the ServiceNow account, used with userName.

proxyPassword.label: proxy,security
proxyPassword.description: The password for basic authentication to the proxy, used with proxyUserName.

proxyUserName.label: proxy,security
proxyUserName.description: The user name for basic authentication to the proxy. It is used only when proxyPassword is also set and proxyAuthorizationPolicy is not set.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The TLS configuration of the connection to the REST API. If not set and useGlobalSslContextParameters is enabled on the component, the global SSL context parameters are used.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Whether to use the global SSL context parameters of the CamelContext when the sslContextParameters option is not set.

userName.label: security
userName.description: The user name of the ServiceNow account. The producer sends it with basic authentication, or in the OAuth password grant when oauthClientId and oauthClientSecret are set.

CamelServiceNowResource.description: The REST API to call: table, aggregate, import, attachment, scorecards, misc, service_catalog, service_catalog_items, service_catalog_cart or service_catalog_categories. It replaces the resource option.

CamelServiceNowAction.description: The action to perform on the resource: retrieve, content, create, modify, delete, update or upload. For the table resource, modify replaces a record (PUT) and update changes only the fields in the body (PATCH).

CamelServiceNowActionSubject.description: The subject that selects the operation when a resource has several for the same action: categories, cart, producer, submit_guide, checkout_guide, performance_analytics, user_role_inheritance, identify_reconcile, delivery_address or checkout. The scorecards and misc resources always need one.

CamelServiceNowModel.description: The class used as both the request model and the response model. It replaces the models option. After a call, the producer sets it to the name of the response model class if it is not set.

CamelServiceNowRequestModel.description: The class of the request body. The producer fails when the body is not an instance of it. It replaces the CamelServiceNowModel header and the requestModels option.

CamelServiceNowResponseModel.description: The class that the producer converts the result to. It replaces the CamelServiceNowModel header and the responseModels option. After a call, the producer sets it to the name of the response model class if it is not set.

CamelServiceNowContentType.description: The content type of the file that the upload action of the attachment resource sends, which the upload requires. The producer sets it to the Content-Type of the response.

CamelServiceNowContentMeta.description: The metadata of the attachment as a Map, which the producer reads from the X-Attachment-Metadata header of the response of the content action.

CamelServiceNowResponseMeta.description: The fields of the response other than result, as a Map of their text values.

CamelServiceNowApiVersion.description: The version of the REST API, for example v1. It replaces the apiVersion option.

CamelServiceNowResponseType.description: The class of the body that the producer set from the result.

CamelServiceNowRetrieveTargetRecord.description: Whether the create action of the import resource returns the record inserted into the target table instead of the import set result. It replaces the retrieveTargetRecordOnImport option.

CamelServiceNowTable.description: The name of the table. It replaces the table option. For the upload action of the attachment resource, it is the table of the record to attach the file to (table_name).

CamelServiceNowSysId.description: The sys_id of the record, attachment, catalog, category, item or cart to act on. Without it, the retrieve action of the table and attachment resources lists the records.

CamelServiceNowUserSysId.description: The sys_id of the user whose roles the user_role_inheritance subject of the misc resource returns (user_sysid).

CamelServiceNowUserId.description: The ID of the user whose delivery address the delivery_address subject of the service_catalog_cart resource returns.

CamelServiceNowCartItemId.description: The ID of the cart item that the update action of the service_catalog_cart resource changes.

CamelServiceNowFileName.description: The name of the file that the upload action of the attachment resource creates (file_name).

CamelServiceNowTableSysId.description: The sys_id of the record that the upload action of the attachment resource attaches the file to (table_sys_id).

CamelServiceNowEncryptionContext.description: The sys_id of the encryption context that the upload action of the attachment resource encrypts the file with (encryption_context).

CamelServiceNowCategory.description: The sys_id of the category to filter the service catalog items by (sysparm_category).

CamelServiceNowType.description: The type of the service catalog items to return (sysparm_type).

CamelServiceNowCatalog.description: The sys_id of the catalog to filter the service catalog items by (sysparm_catalog).

CamelServiceNowQuery.description: The encoded query that filters the records, for example active=truepriority=1 (sysparm_query).

CamelServiceNowDisplayValue.description: Whether ServiceNow returns the display values (true), the actual values (false) or both (all) of the fields. It replaces the displayValue option.

CamelServiceNowInputDisplayValue.description: Whether ServiceNow treats the field values of a create or change as display values. It replaces the inputDisplayValue option.

CamelServiceNowExcludeReferenceLink.description: Whether ServiceNow leaves out the Table API links of reference fields. It replaces the excludeReferenceLink option.

CamelServiceNowFields.description: The comma-separated names of the fields to return (sysparm_fields).

CamelServiceNowLimit.description: The maximum number of records to return (sysparm_limit).

CamelServiceNowText.description: The text to search the service catalog items for (sysparm_text).

CamelServiceNowOffset.description: The index of the first record to return, for paging (sysparm_offset).

CamelServiceNowView.description: The UI view whose fields to return: desktop, mobile or both (sysparm_view).

CamelServiceNowSuppressAutoSysField.description: Whether ServiceNow does not generate the system fields when a record is created or changed. It replaces the suppressAutoSysField option.

CamelServiceNowSuppressPaginationHeader.description: Whether ServiceNow leaves out the Link header of the response, from which the producer reads the paging offsets. It replaces the suppressPaginationHeader option.

CamelServiceNowMinFields.description: The comma-separated fields whose minimum the aggregate resource returns (sysparm_min_fields).

CamelServiceNowMaxFields.description: The comma-separated fields whose maximum the aggregate resource returns (sysparm_max_fields).

CamelServiceNowSumFields.description: The comma-separated fields whose sum the aggregate resource returns (sysparm_sum_fields).

CamelServiceNowAvgFields.description: The comma-separated fields whose average the aggregate resource returns (sysparm_avg_fields).

CamelServiceNowCount.description: Whether the aggregate resource returns the number of records (sysparm_count).

CamelServiceNowGroupBy.description: The comma-separated fields to group the aggregate results by (sysparm_group_by).

CamelServiceNowOrderBy.description: The comma-separated fields to order the aggregate groups by (sysparm_order_by).

CamelServiceNowHaving.description: The condition on an aggregate that the groups must meet, as aggregatefieldoperatorvalue, for example countpriority>3 (sysparm_having).

CamelServiceNowUUID.description: The colon-separated sys_ids of the indicator, and optionally of its breakdown, element and aggregate, whose scorecards to return (sysparm_uuid).

CamelServiceNowBreakdown.description: The sys_id of the breakdown that organizes the returned scorecards (sysparm_breakdown).

CamelServiceNowIncludeScores.description: Whether to return all scores of a scorecard instead of only the most recent one. It replaces the includeScores option.

CamelServiceNowIncludeScoreNotes.description: Whether to return the notes of each score. It replaces the includeScoreNotes option.

CamelServiceNowIncludeAggregates.description: Whether to return all available aggregates of an indicator, also when an aggregate is already applied. It replaces the includeAggregates option.

CamelServiceNowIncludeAvailableBreakdown.description: Whether to return all available breakdowns of an indicator. It replaces the includeAvailableBreakdowns option.

CamelServiceNowIncludeAvailableAggregate.description: Whether to return all available aggregates of an indicator when no aggregate is applied. It replaces the includeAvailableAggregates option.

CamelServiceNowFavorites.description: Whether to return only the scorecards that are favorites of the user. It replaces the favorites option.

CamelServiceNowKey.description: Whether to return only the scorecards of key indicators. It replaces the key option.

CamelServiceNowTarget.description: Whether to return only the scorecards that have a target. It replaces the target option.

CamelServiceNowDisplay.description: Which scorecards to return by the Display field of their indicator: true for only those with Display selected, all for any. It replaces the display option.

CamelServiceNowPerPage.description: The maximum number of scorecards to return per page, at most 100. It replaces the perPage option.

CamelServiceNowSortBy.description: The value to sort the scorecards by. It replaces the sortBy option.

CamelServiceNowSortDir.description: The sort direction of the scorecards, asc or desc. It replaces the sortDir option.

CamelServiceNowContains.description: The comma-separated names or descriptions of the indicators whose scorecards to return (sysparm_contains).

CamelServiceNowTags.description: The comma-separated sys_ids of the indicator groups whose scorecards to return (sysparm_tags).

CamelServiceNowPage.description: The number of the page of scorecards to return, with perPage scorecards per page (sysparm_page).

CamelServiceNowElementsFilter.description: The sys_id of the elements filter to apply to the returned scorecards (sysparm_elements_filter).

CamelServiceNowBreakdownRelation.description: The sys_id of the breakdown relation to break down the returned scorecards by (sysparm_breakdown_relation).

CamelServiceNowDataSource.description: The source of the configuration item data that the identify_reconcile subject of the misc resource sends (sysparm_data_source).

CamelServiceNowTopLevelOnly.description: Whether to return only the categories whose parent is the catalog. It replaces the topLevelOnly option.

producerIn.description: The record to create, modify or update must be an instance of the request model: a Map by default, an object of the class set with models or requestModels or the CamelServiceNowRequestModel header, or JSON text with a String model; another body fails. An attachment upload sends the body as a stream, with its content type in the CamelServiceNowContentType header. A retrieve or delete does not read the body: the action, table and sys_id are headers

producerOut.description: The result of the call: a Map of the record, or a List of Maps for many, or objects of the response model class set with models or responseModels or the CamelServiceNowResponseModel header (the JSON text with a String model). The content of an attachment is an InputStream. A response with no content, such as a delete, leaves the body; the paging offsets and the other response fields are headers

instanceName.description: The name of the ServiceNow instance, the first part of its host name {instanceName}.service-now.com. The producer builds the default apiUrl and oauthTokenUrl from it.

display.description: Which scorecards a scorecards request returns by the Display field of their indicator: true for only those with Display selected, all for any (sysparm_display). The CamelServiceNowDisplay header replaces this option.

key.description: Whether a scorecards request returns only the scorecards of key indicators (sysparm_key). The CamelServiceNowKey header replaces this option.

perPage.description: The maximum number of scorecards that a scorecards request returns per page, at most 100 (sysparm_per_page). The CamelServiceNowPerPage header replaces this option.

dateFormat.label: advanced
dateFormat.description: The java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter pattern of the LocalDate fields of the models in the JSON. It is not used when the mapper option is set.

dateTimeFormat.label: advanced
dateTimeFormat.description: The java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter pattern of the LocalDateTime fields of the models in the JSON. It is not used when the mapper option is set.

httpClientPolicy.label: advanced
httpClientPolicy.description: To use a custom Apache CXF org.apache.cxf.transports.http.configuration.HTTPClientPolicy for the HTTP connection, for example for timeouts. When it is set, the proxyHost and proxyPort options are not used.

mapper.description: To use a custom Jackson tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper, which must be a JsonMapper, to convert the request and the response. When it is set, the dateFormat, timeFormat and dateTimeFormat options are not used.

proxyAuthorizationPolicy.label: advanced
proxyAuthorizationPolicy.description: To use a custom Apache CXF org.apache.cxf.configuration.security.ProxyAuthorizationPolicy for the authentication to the proxy. When it is set, the proxyUserName and proxyPassword options are not used.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the HTTP proxy. The proxy is used only when proxyPort is also set and httpClientPolicy is not set.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the HTTP proxy, used with proxyHost.

apiUrl.label: security
apiUrl.description: The base URL of the ServiceNow REST API. If not set, https://{instanceName}.service-now.com/api is used.

oauthClientId.label: security

oauthClientSecret.label: security

oauthTokenUrl.label: security

password.label: security
password.description: The password of the ServiceNow account, used with userName.

proxyPassword.label: proxy,security
proxyPassword.description: The password for basic authentication to the proxy, used with proxyUserName.

proxyUserName.label: proxy,security
proxyUserName.description: The user name for basic authentication to the proxy. It is used only when proxyPassword is also set and proxyAuthorizationPolicy is not set.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The TLS configuration of the connection to the REST API. If not set and useGlobalSslContextParameters is enabled on the component, the global SSL context parameters are used.

userName.label: security
userName.description: The user name of the ServiceNow account. The producer sends it with basic authentication, or in the OAuth password grant when oauthClientId and oauthClientSecret are set.
